display: I am working on building a Tableau dashboard extension that will surface agentic use-cases. I want to build this to run as a standalone without the need of automation platforms like n8n. For the agentic side I would like to provide the possibility to bring-your-own model and potentially in the future add local model compatability. I want this flow to be programmable easily in that I can code in new tools but then to program the workflow just a JSON file needs to be updated. As a first use-case I am thinking of an extension that looks into our Planning data for a consultancy and informs the consultant of upcoming open days, then each consultant can have a running list of tasks they want to get done stored in a google doc, the agent picks those up and asks clarifying questions to clarify times and plan those tasks in by putting it into Planning and if required setting Calendar invites for specific project steps and times around existing calendar engagements. In addition everyone in the organization can also have a section that shows open work/support needed that the agent picks up and checks with the consultant if they are the right person to help and are willing to contribute to it.

Today Consultants can enter their planning on the Smartsheet but they need to look at the Planning dashboard, check messages on Slack to clarify requests, check email back-and-forth with client (this we might not be able to avoid) and then go to Smartsheets to request and then potentially answer additional requests on the request triggered from Smartsheet to Slack. On success: Adoption rate would be the key KPI and further testimonials on time saved. On scope: The possibliity to directly update the database for planning changes, proactively notifying consultants about open days and even planning in existing open work. On bigger vision: Consulting Accelerator product first and then a marketplace of agent workflows

On core insight: It is meant to be an extension for Tableau dashboards and Tableau users, all the others require pulling the data elsewhere and acting on it, whereas this approach helps you act where your data is. On differentiation: It is about the simplicity about planning their own day right within the tool they review their upcoming days. On vision: The platform is the real product and the consultant planning assistant is just the first prrof point

I am working on a Tableau Next POC with a client who uses Salesforce regularly. This is a fixed scope project where we just have about 12 days to build and I want to showcase the fit of this technology, Tableau next at the client and their use-case. The client wants to build an overview into their Customer support request process, specifically for remote support. I want to build out a project plan and set clear expectations for what the client is responsible for and what we as consultants are responsible for. I want to also have clear timelines and when the client should have things ready and when we will have to delay if things are missing
How long would this journey take?

Clarification, the client knows they won't have Productiong data ready but they will have sample data prepped. We need a good collection of data that we can use with good customer request journeys modelled for different types of clients. If it comes late then it will be harder for us to reschedule our time and find other billable clients for our work, which means we lose the time we scheduled for the client

The client must have 10 customer requests mapped out with the data fields needed. We might need to give the required data fields first though to ensure the client has the right stuff ready. The consequence 5 days in advance is that we can reschedule, less than 5 days means we can't reschedule and we lose the time planned
That breaks the diversity of the dashboard and we will not have a convincing POC.

They would need to see that the customer request journey can be mapped and in additon the service leads are able to intervene and escalate or redirect the requests to ensure greater customer satisfaction during the process
The intervention is key here, the value of Tableau Next lies in the fact that it can be a visualization layer but also provide actionability within the Salesforce platform
They have a sandbox indeed and that can be a copy of production, we have this assurance from the client
